conceptual_change: Introduce a volatility-adjusted position sizing multiplier that scales down exposure linearly as the current ATR_14 value exceeds the 20-period moving average of ATR_14 by more than 1.5 standard deviations, rather than using a hard binary entry filter.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: The previous attempt (BC 19) failed due to unexecutable hard-coded entry logic; replacing this with a dynamic sizing mechanism allows the execution engine to handle volatility-adjusted exposure without requiring new engine state triggers, while still testing the underlying thesis that high-volatility environments negatively impact strategy performance.
